releaseTitle: DCEAY v2.0.0 — One App, All Your Music
changelog:
DCEAY v2.0.0 Official Release — One App, All Your Music.
• Cover-to-Background Engine: real-time album cover color sampling, adjustable Gaussian blur slider (10px–80px), and animated mesh gradients.
• Syllable-Synced Lyrics Studio: word-by-word and syllable-by-syllable karaoke highlighting, bilingual translation toggle, adjustable font size, live timing calibration (-200ms to +200ms), and LRC timestamp editor.
• Universal Link & Smart Playlist Importer: supports YouTube videos, YouTube playlists, Spotify tracks, Spotify playlists/albums, direct audio URLs (MP3/FLAC/WAV/M4A), and local device audio with automatic duplicate detection.
• Home-Screen App Icon Switcher: switch between 5 built-in launcher icons (DCEAY Default, Cyberpunk Neon, Liquid Glass, Emerald Matrix, Monochrome) via Android activity aliases.
• Personalization Studio: Cyberpunk Neon (#ff00ff / #00ffff with double borders), Glassmorphism (#14141e99 / #e6e6e6 / #ffffff1a), Midnight Slate, Emerald Forest, and Clean Light themes.
• GitHub Releases Online Auto-Updater: checks MEYYYNASH/DCEAY releases, verifies SHA-256 checksums and package signing identity, and triggers Android PackageInstaller.
